title: Flame Bold Variable
slide_intent: Treat variable width as a compositional instrument because changing proportions can turn a short word into a graphic surface.
strategic_value: A range from narrow to broad Flame capitals can let Burger King fill a format without abandoning its recognizable letter shapes.
demonstration: Rows of oversized M capitals progress through narrow and wide proportions beside a short variable-type explanation.
practical_value: Reserve this width range for the full-page type applications named in the source.

content_islands.name: Scope explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the descriptive paragraph at upper left.

content_islands.name: Width comparison
content_islands.spec: Use enlarged cream M shapes across the right and lower areas, including cropped extremes.

ingredient.name: Flame Bold variable capitals
ingredient.role: Let words occupy a graphic field through width variation.
ingredient.application: Use the variable capitals from Super-Condensed through Regular to Super-Wide only in full-page type applications.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. The printed cross-reference names page 79 as a layout section, although physical 79 is Typography Don’ts; the actual variable-layout example is page 93. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Expression: Repeated M capitals reveal the width range of Flame Bold.
reference_purposes.Application: The copy identifies Super-Condensed, Regular and Super-Wide options.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page restricts variable type to applications with a full page of type.
